mac.protocol: PPCE magic+epoch, 32-bit free-running producer/consumer counts in 64-bit words; payload before publishing producer
mac.rtl: Dual-clock packet buffers, 64-bit Avalon DDR master; burst reads, one-beat writes

sun.protocol: Magic published last, generation, producer/consumer counters, barriers
sun.rtl: Standalone DDR master, arbitration with memory/video; LANCE remains RTL
sun.tests: Source reviewed; random DDR wait/read latency, reset, full/wrap, oversize, ordering and pacing. Tests NOT rerun here.

amiga.transport: DDR mailbox with additional device/register-model semantics; less direct reuse for Dorado
amiga.execution: Source explicitly states Main single-thread poll loop

findings.main_execution: Reviewed Sun/NeXT/Mac code is polled from Main; DDR transport alone does not make it independent of blocking Main disk I/O

dorado_decision.pattern: Reuse frame-only rings, generation/capability and publish/consume ownership, not guest NIC emulation
dorado_decision.daemon: Standalone ARM dorado-server directly services DDR queues; Main only lifecycle/OSD configuration
dorado_decision.preserve: Original DskEth, Manchester wire timing, real CRC and current Pup server packet format
dorado_decision.address: Do not reuse Mac 0x30400000: overlaps current Dorado 0x30000000..0x30ffffff backing. Choose explicit reserved non-overlap after full map audit; 0x1FF00000 is a precedent, not yet allocated here.
dorado_decision.capacity: Preserve 2048-byte Dorado MAX_WORDS1024 payload; 2048-byte slot with inline header is too small. Separate descriptors or larger slots.
dorado_decision.coherence: Define endian/order, 32-bit ownership fields, barriers/mapping, full/empty, wrap, abort/reset/drain and stale-generation rules
dorado_decision.timing: Host DDR engine must run while guest clock pauses; retain original wire pacing and backpressure
dorado_decision.fallback: Keep qualified SPI/Unix-socket route selectable during qualification
dorado_decision.status: Design/references reviewed; DDR network path NOT implemented
dorado_decision.lifecycle: Main must stop/quiesce daemon and receive ACK before core change; validate fresh capability/generation before resume. DDR magic persists across FPGA reload.

external_compatibility.future: Optional IFS/ContrAlto-compatible UDP encapsulation to vintage peers; ordinary TCP/IP services need guest support or explicit translation
